notes: Canadian stations in the imported dial tier, beside radio_imported.json. Built by `cargo tools import-canada-stations` from a Radio Browser snapshot (stream addresses only) joined to ISED's Broadcasting Database (export of 2026-11-24): by the call sign in the station's name or CBC stream mount, or else by the one dial position in its name and the province in its directory entry when exactly one operating ISED transmitter there matches. Read from ISED: lat, lon, frequency_mhz, market (the licensed community) and state (the province). Derived: range_miles, from the largest licensed FM ERP through the US tier's power table; AM is a flat 25 miles. One row per station, at its main transmitter; rebroadcasters are not placed. A call sign or stream already on the dial wins, and streams the sweep found dead are left out (see radio_stream_health.json).
